semantics.execution: jdk.ExecutionSample event counts, not elapsed CPU time or CPU utilization. Sampling excludes threads not executing Java code.
semantics.native: jdk.NativeMethodSample event counts, separate from execution samples; native samples can include executing or waiting threads.
semantics.attribution: First recognized subsystem frame scanning from stack leaf toward root; unrecognized library leaf frames are skipped. This is stack-path attribution, not exclusive method CPU cost. Inclusive tracked-method counts overlap. Injected methods in transformed vanilla classes retain vanilla attribution; overloaded methods are grouped by class and method name.
semantics.allocation: jdk.ObjectAllocationSample.weight sums estimate allocation pressure in bytes; not exact allocations, retained heap, or a memory leak measurement.
semantics.duration_events: Phase membership uses event startTime in [startUtc, endUtc). Full durations of selected I/O, park, monitor and GC events are retained, so they may extend beyond a phase boundary. Durations can overlap across threads and must not be summed into total wall time.
semantics.io: Only recorded file I/O events are counted; recording thresholds may omit short operations. Recorded bytes and durations are not total filesystem throughput.
semantics.gc: Top-level GCPhasePause durations and GarbageCollection.sumOfPauses are separate summaries of potentially overlapping observations; never add them together.
semantics.scope: Full-recording views include startup/shutdown. Probe views use explicit UTC windows. All-thread sample scopes can include concurrent background work.
semantics.timings: Probe elapsedNanos are observed workload wall times, including recorder overhead where active. A single run is not a controlled speedup result.
